Description: Event timing and trial metadata for the visual sequence mismatch detection (VISSEQ) task.

weight.Description: Trial weight for GLM modeling. Always 1 for all trials in this dataset.

memtype.Description: Behavioral response outcome for the trial.

Levels.1: Hit — intact sequence correctly identified as old.
Levels.2: Miss — intact sequence incorrectly identified as new.
Levels.3: Correct rejection — manipulated sequence correctly identified as new.
Levels.4: False alarm — manipulated sequence incorrectly identified as old.

resolution.Description: Mismatch distance between the studied and test sequence attributes at the critical serial position.

Levels.1: Near — swapped attributes were similar (close in semantic embedding space or adjacent spatial locations).
Levels.2: Far — swapped attributes were dissimilar (distant in semantic embedding space or opposing spatial locations).

memcond.Description: Type of sequence manipulation at test.

Levels.1: Intact — test sequence was identical to the studied sequence.
Levels.2: Object swap — the object at the critical serial position was swapped with one from another sequence.
Levels.3: Location swap — the location of the object at the critical serial position was swapped with one from another sequence.
Levels.4: Both swap — both the object and location at the critical serial position were swapped.

Levels.1: Study — encoding phase in which the object sequence was presented.
Levels.2: Test — retrieval phase in which the probe sequence was presented for old/new judgment.
Levels.3: Response — response period during which the participant indicated old or new.

run.Description: Run number. Redundant with the BIDS filename run index.

eye.Description: Whether the event corresponds to a fixation event recorded by the EyeLink 1000 Plus eye tracker (500 Hz).
